notes.title: The Chronicle 1.2.00 Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

I just released a new update for The Chronicle. These updates include a over all game size reduction to half it's previous size, I have done a ton of optimizing to the game, so it should run on much lower end machine now.

I also made a bunch of quality of life improvements and bugs fixes. I removed the angry chicken at the 
log cabin, as he was causing some issues. If I can figure them out, I will add him back in.

Hope you all are doing well, thanks so much for all the support, and if you have a chance, please check out my new game RAGE Available on Google play (Android) and PC. 

https://artstrong.itch.io/rage

Thanks again,

-ArtStrong

 Is this weeks update I have added a ton of new content. Fixed a bunch off bugs. I am not good at patch notes sorry, you'll just have to play to find all the stuff a added or changed.

notes.title: Game Update 2.0 Pet The Dog
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Sorry it's been so long, As some of you may know. I thought I lost the working files for the game. it wasn't till recently I found a Backup copy of a build that was nearly complete. So I finished the build and then went about fixing all the bugs and issues the current live version has, then added a TON more content to the game. I did take some content out as it was causing issue with performance, but I have added more then enough to compensate for it. 

Did a mention, You can pet the dog now?... :)

I will continue to improve on The Chronicle and add more content over the next few months.

This game does not hold your hand, Best way to get the most out of this game is to Explore, there is so much cool stuff to find. :) 

Thanks so much for all the awesome support, I look forward to hearing your feedback.

May The Hue Be With You.

ArtStrong

notes.title: Were flipping the switch.
notes.content:
Well Hello There! 

First off, thanks to everyone for their support through out this beta, it's been short, stressful but successful.

I have decided to call the first chapter done and go full release.

No fear thou, this last update is full of cool content and improvements.  :) So here are your patch notes for the Chapter 1 release Update.

- New Content and story items (Bulk of the update)
- A new friend?
- A bunch of mesh and texture optimization
- Fixed a bunch of lighting issues
- Game Ending has been redone :)

Thanks again to everyone who supporting this project. 

Here's to the road ahead :)

"May the hue be with you all"

- ArtStrong

tags.feature: - New Content and story items (Bulk of the update)

notes.title: This is a BIG one.
notes.content:
Hey all, 

Thanks for all the great support and feedback. I have taken this feedback and made quite a lot of
tweaks and changes.

- Many tweaks and changes some you will notice others you will not.
- I have added a brand new furry friend, she's waiting to meet you.
- The pause menu glitch has been fixed.
- I have made a bunch of mesh and textures changes to help with frame rates for lower end PCs.
- I have also added a bunch of new content for you to explore and find.

Future Updates:

I will be adding even more content for the next update. 


Thanks so much for the support and feedback, and I hope your enjoying my first horror game as much as
I did creating it.

-ArtStrong <3
